mandate: Execute all approved liquidity/runway recommendations together without narrowing universe, capping right-tail winners, or using hindsight in live eligibility.

upgrades.entry_runway: P(+0.75R), P(+1.50R), Expected Executable Excursion, predicted net-R and liquidity-sufficiency proxy
upgrades.runway_learning: 112-day regularized nearest-state model trained only on promotions exited before each evaluation week
upgrades.adaptive_profit_banking: 0-60% cumulative according to causal continuation/runway deterioration
upgrades.runner: all unbanked size remains on frozen exit path with no global 3R ceiling
upgrades.loss_treatment: preserve V2 negative-edge gate and add causal insufficient-runway rejection/risk scaling
upgrades.flat_treatment: monetize developed but weak-continuation trades rather than forcing all positions through the same horizon
upgrades.capacity_after_partial: no extra capacity credit; conservative replay
upgrades.direct_order_book_liquidity: not present in historical evidence; this replay uses the approved causal liquidity proxy layer

causality.training: historical MFE and outcomes permitted only as labels after exit and only for prior weeks
causality.management: checkpoint re-underwriting occurs only when the contemporaneous path first reaches that checkpoint

promotion: No automatic promotion. Report all deltas versus locked V2.
